newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks open with mixed trend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks open with mixed trend.

text.p: Dhaka stocks opened mixed on Sunday and brokers expect the market to close lower on profit-taking.
"The market is mixed this moment with both buyers and sellers actively trading. But at the close the index may fall slightly on profit taking," said one broker.

Aziz pipes gained 10 taka to 1,060, Aftab Automobiles dropped three to 337 and Bata Shoe was up five to 146. The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index closed 39.46 points or 3.71 percent up at 1,101.68 on Saturday.
